name: Raspberry Pi 5
notes: Origin = board lower-left corner with the GPIO header along the top long edge; holes for M2.5. USB-C power and 2x micro-HDMI on the bottom long edge (x offsets from left edge); 2x USB stacks + Ethernet on the right short edge (y offsets from bottom edge). PCB thickness and component height are not dimensioned on this drawing; Ethernet/USB overhang the right edge by ~3 mm.

name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B
notes: Origin = board lower-left corner, GPIO header along the top long edge; M2.5 holes. USB-C and 2x micro-HDMI on bottom long edge (x from left: 3.5+7.7, +14.8, +13.5 chained dims); Ethernet (top) and 2x dual USB-A on the right short edge (y from bottom). Heights are the drawing's Z values above the PCB top; PCB thickness not given on drawing.

name: Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040)
notes: Origin = lower-left corner viewed from top with the micro-USB at the top short edge (y=51); holes 2 mm from the short edges and 11.4 mm apart, centred. Micro-USB overhangs top edge by 1.3 mm (typ). 2x20 castellated 0.1in pads on long edges. Matches app parts library (51 x 21 x 1.0, 4x 2.1 holes 47 x 11.4).

name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (RP2350)
notes: Same outline and hole pattern as Pico 1 (origin = lower-left, micro-USB on top short edge, holes 2 mm from short edges). Pico 2 W drawing is identical in outline/holes. PCB thickness read from the '1' callout on the drawing.

name: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
notes: Origin = lower-left corner, GPIO header along top long edge; mini-HDMI, micro-USB data and micro-USB power all on the bottom long edge (x from left edge); camera connector on right short edge. Hole diameter not dimensioned on the official drawing (other Pi boards use 2.7 mm for M2.5).

name: Arduino Uno Rev3
notes: Origin = lower-left corner, top view, USB-B (upper) and DC barrel jack (lower) on the left short edge. Arduino datasheet gives 4x 3.2 mm holes, 15.24/2.54 mm (top-left hole) and 66.04 mm, 17.78/45.72 mm from top (right holes); the bottom-left hole x and connector positions come from the KiCad Arduino_UNO_R3_WithMountingHoles footprint (outline 68.58 x 53.34). Store lists 68.6 x 53.4 mm, 25 g.

name: Arduino Nano (ATmega328, A000005)
notes: Official drawing: 43.2 x 18, 4x Ø1.8 corner holes 40.64 x 15.24 apart, 1.6 PCB. Hole coords assume the pattern is centred on the PCB (origin lower-left, mini-USB on the right short edge) - estimate. Store says '18 x 45 mm'. App parts library has 43.2 x 18.5: width disagrees with official 18.

name: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4 (WROOM-32)
notes: No mounting holes. Micro-USB on the bottom short edge (centred); WROOM module antenna overhangs the opposite short edge by 6.04 mm. App parts library 54.4 x 27.9 agrees if it includes the antenna overhang (official 48.26 PCB + 6.04 = 54.3).

name: DOIT ESP32 DevKit V1 (30-pin)
notes: Clone board, community caliper measurement (Fritzing forum): 51.8 x 28.2, 4x 2.8 mm holes with 0.8 mm hole-edge-to-board-edge clearance, 43.9 mm between holes along the length; seller figure 51.5 x 28.3 (= app parts library). Micro-USB on one short edge, antenna on the other. Clones vary.

name: Espressif ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 v1.1
notes: No mounting holes. Two micro-USB ports (UART left, native USB right, top view) on the bottom short edge; WROOM-1 PCB antenna at the opposite edge within the outline. App parts library 62.7 x 25.5: width differs by 0.1 from official 25.40.

name: BIGTREETECH SKR Mini E3 V3.0
notes: Origin = lower-left corner, top view (stepper connectors along top edge, power/HB/E0 screw terminals at bottom-left, endstop/fan/thermistor JST along bottom edge). MicroSD slot and USB on the right short edge (USB between 21.88-30.26 mm from top). BTT SIZE drawing shows 5 holes; dims are its chained values converted to lower-left origin. Hole diameter not dimensioned. Official drawing gives 103.75 mm, not ~101.5.

name: 16x2 character LCD module (HD44780/KS0066, 1602A)
notes: GDM1602A drawing (generic 1602A outline); origin lower-left, 16-pin header along top edge starting ~7.5 mm from left. Datasheet gives 4x Ø2.5 holes, not 3.5. Height 15 max with LED backlight (9.5 without); the PCF8574 I2C backpack soldered on the back adds depth not covered here.

name: 20x4 character LCD module (2004A)
notes: EONE 2004A spec (via Velleman). Origin lower-left; 16-pin header along top edge, pin 1 at 10 mm from left. Height 13.0 max is module depth from PCB back to bezel front; I2C backpack (if fitted) adds depth.

name: 0.96in 128x64 I2C OLED module (SSD1306, 4-pin)
notes: LCDWiki MC096GX drawing; origin lower-left, 4-pin header (VCC GND SCL SDA, pin order varies by clone) along top edge. Holes 2.0 mm from edges per drawing (one '1.50' callout at top is ambiguous). Matches app parts library (27.3 x 27.8, holes 23.3 x 23.8, Ø2.0).

name: 1.3in 128x64 I2C OLED module (SH1106, 4-pin)
notes: LCDWiki MC130VX PCB size and active area. Hole positions not verified (size drawing link was dead); 4-pin header VCC GND SCL SDA on top edge. Other sellers' 1.3in boards differ (e.g. 35.5 x 33.7).

name: 2.8in 240x320 SPI TFT module (ILI9341, MSP2807 red PCB)
notes: LCDWiki MSP2807 outline (touch version). Origin lower-left, portrait, 14-pin header along the bottom short edge (2.0 mm from edge, first pin 8.49 mm from left); top holes 3.0 mm from top edge. MicroSD slot on the back.
